design: A7Z roof saddle V3: Radxa 6530B heatsink on the board, USB-C/HDMI through the rear wall, 40-pin header at the front edge, saddle floor carries the board, 3M foam tape fixes the saddle, lid is a cover

quotes: 评估 USB 朝后、排针朝前的背包座：摄像头线怎么走、线够不够长、风扇和天线放哪、要重印哪些件
我们需要有一个新的背包设计 那些插口肯定应该朝外 怎么可能超这脖子呢
这是我的风扇的图片 已经到货了 是正好盖在a7z上面的
设计时还要关注板子天线出来的地方 边上太窄 天线就不好走了 另外天线贴着散热片会不会有问题 你都兼顾一下 还有就是走线了 IMU和openrb从下往上的 以及XIAO，扬声器和麦克风从上往下的 都应该可以方便地走线 然后a7z的3个插口都可以从框外面方便的插
散热片占了a7z的螺丝孔 那么原来的固定方案就不行了 需要螺丝从框下面往上打了
杜邦线那边别用盖子盖住 容易把线压住 镂空有什么不好吗
ac019是天线的话，线长4-5cm … 完全不需要20cm … a7z已经有天线了 只是贴的位置不对 就出问题 我理解是很难接受的
这个sd卡插进去以后 拔不出来吧 这个插槽不是弹簧插槽
再有就是上面下来的杜邦线 不需要从鞍座的下面绕上去吧
那tray起什么作用呢 … 为什么不能从saddle的底板往上拧螺丝固定a7z呢
盖板直接压实在散热片上 我理解散热片有可能会温度相当高 而PLA你说60度就开始软化了 这不会有问题吗
侧板也太丑了 不可接受 我宁愿用3M的0.5mm的泡沫双面胶来固定
按底板载体 + 3M 0.5 mm 泡沫胶固定 + 盖板只罩不压出 CAD，过 gate，重切
approved.history: 2026-10-22 concept B (a7z-slice-20261022/render_concept_b.py) was approved with the header at the front and USB-C at the rear; build_saddle.py V1.29 turned the board round without a recorded reason and D-022 copied the CAD. The copper block + 30 mm fan in V1.29 were never bought; the 6530B was ordered 2026-10-22 04:01 and arrived 2026-10-25. 2026-10-25 bound form corrected by the agent (not an approval change): the three socket checks were x_max < -38, which depends on the 8 mm socket depth; the approved property is the socket face at the rear wall, so the check is x_min < -43. Requirement 3 reworded by the agent from 'own window each' to 'one window over the three sockets': the right-angle camera plug body is 21.8 wide and covers ② and HDMI. 2026-10-25 evening: the head wires came under the front wall foot through the floor cut (V1.29 leftover) and the card slot was a flush slot for a push-push socket; Shawn's two quotes above: head wires come over the front wall (its top lowered to z 63 over the strip), the card gets a tweezer notch (the socket is a friction socket). Requirement 2 reworded, requirement 7 added. 2026-10-25 night (V3): Shawn rejected the V2 tray (loose on posts, held only by the lid pressing the heatsink) and the side-lug alternative; V3 = the saddle floor carries the board (four M2 x 6 from below on the bench), the unit is taped to the shell roof with 3M 0.5 mm foam tape, the lid is a cover that touches nothing. Requirements 4 and 5 rewritten; the print material is PLA (an earlier PETG note was wrong).

concept_render: flip-concept-20261025/flip-A.png (orientation and camera route approved; its fan and lid are the old wrong part and are superseded by the 6530B)

geometry.says: USB-C ② opening in the rear wall, plug reaches it from behind the robot (socket face within 2 mm of the rear outer face x -45)
USB-C ① opening in the rear wall, not covered by the camera plug (socket face within 2 mm of the rear outer face x -45)
micro HDMI opening in the rear wall (socket face within 2 mm of the rear outer face x -45)
40-pin header at the front edge; head and torso wires drop straight to the floor opening
Radxa 6530B 65 x 30 x 11.5 on the board, fan intake upward
camera right-angle plug body behind the rear wall, leg to +y, port ① free
AC019 on the front wall inner face, at least 10 mm from the 6530B aluminium, never on a wall the heatsink touches

requirements: IPEX pigtail: a channel at least 2 mm wide beside the board's +y end (x -34..-22, z 47..58) so the 1.13 mm coax can turn from under the heatsink and run along the wall to the antenna; the wall bulges outward there, never grows upward The pigtail is 40-50 mm: the antenna's feed end sits within 40 mm of the IPEX (board left end), so the AC019 lies on the front wall inner face with its feed end at the left (+y) end; no extension cable.

Torso wires (IMU 4, UART 2, 5 V 2) rise through the floor cut (x -21..-5, |y| <= 16; its run-out under the front wall foot carries the ID12 neck servo cable and the IMU plug) straight into the front-edge housings; the head wires (amp 5, XIAO 4, mic 2) come from the neck straight over the front wall top, lowered to z 63 over |y| <= 28, into the open strip; no head wire goes under the saddle or through the floor cut; housings are plugged from above with the lid off

USB-C ①, USB-C ② and micro HDMI are reachable through the rear wall with at least 1 mm around every plug overmould (one window over the three sockets, since the camera's right-angle plug body spans ② and the HDMI socket); all three are plugged from behind the robot without removing anything

Board + 6530B is one unit with the saddle: on the bench, saddle upside down, four M2 x 6 go up through dia 4.2 head pockets and dia 2.2 holes in four floor bosses (dia 6.6, dia 6.0 for the top 1 mm, floor to the PCB underside z 48), through the board holes into the 6530B's threaded bosses. No tray, no posts, no clamp: these four screws are the only thing holding the board. The two roof screws (-21.5, +-20, the shells' own M2 x 6; the saddle floor has dia 5 holes over their heads) are driven into the pack bar before the saddle goes on and end under the board; the saddle unit is fixed to the shell roof with 3M 0.5 mm foam double-sided tape under the floor (the 0.5 floor gap is the tape): no screw into the shells, no lug, no hole drilled.

Lid covers only the heatsink (x -45..about -20) and is a cover, not a clamp: intake grille over the blower (+y end), lip inside the three closed walls, two side screws into bosses that end at least 1 mm above the heatsink; no bar, pad or rib touches the heatsink (PLA creeps against a 50-60 C heatsink). The header strip (x about -20..-5) stays open at the top: no lid over the Dupont housings, plugs reachable from above at any time; the front wall top is lowered over the strip so the head wires come over it. Exhaust slots at the -y end and along the fin sides.
The old board-on-posts mount (M2 x 4 from above into floor posts) is gone: the 6530B's own screws occupy the four board holes.

microSD: the A7Z socket is a friction (push-pull) socket; the inserted card ends flush with the -y wall's outer face, so the wall has a notch round the card end (card width + 3 mm each side, z 44.5..50.5) through which tweezers pinch the card out
